provenance: TECHRec (Technology Recognition: LTE/WiFi/DVB-T), real captured IQ, 1 MHz (10Msps files excluded). 1024-length slices, up to 512 per capture record. Split by capture location (train merelbeke/rabot/gentbrugge/igent, val uz, test reep) -> cross-location generalization. group = capture file. sample_rate_hz=1e6; center_frequency_hz varies per file (unavailable per-file).
